name: UserTesting
description: UserTesting is a human-insights platform for surveys, interaction tests, moderated research, participant sessions, UX metrics, videos, and transcripts.
agentUseSummary: Add customer-owned API client credentials, then let selected agents read at most 25 completed-session summaries and aggregate QXscores for one exact modern test. Relay does not expose participant IDs or demographics, task responses, transcripts, videos, signed URLs, legacy APIs, or writes.

credentialRequirements.label: UserTesting API client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The client ID issued by UserTesting support for an API-enabled workspace member.

credentialRequirements.label: UserTesting API client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: The matching client secret; Relay requests only the studies:read scope.

capabilities.label: Read test results
capabilities.description: Use two pinned Results API v2 reads for at most 25 completed-session summaries and aggregate QXscores, without participant details or media.

allowed.label: Read UserTesting results
allowed.description: Read bounded completed-session summaries and aggregate QXscores for one exact modern test.

blocked.label: Change UserTesting
blocked.description: Studies, sessions, audiences, clips, highlights, and every mutation are outside Relay's V1 contract.

blocked.label: Read participant or media details
blocked.description: Participant IDs and demographics, task-level responses, transcripts, videos, clips, highlights, and temporary signed URLs are blocked.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary UserTesting APIs
blocked.description: Legacy v1, detailed v3, media, transcript, arbitrary path, method, body, and query access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Two minimized Results API reads run directly. Participant IDs and demographics, task-level responses, transcripts, videos, signed URLs, legacy APIs, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one read tool with two pinned Results API operations through encrypted customer client credentials.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned UserTesting Advanced-or-higher workspace, API-enabled member credentials, representative modern test, or safe results fixture is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: A workspace member obtains client credentials from UserTesting support and stores them through Relay Console, then verifies token issuance, both minimized reads, agent assignment, credential replacement, disconnect, provider-side rotation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: UserTesting documents support-issued client credentials, the fixed token endpoint, studies:read scope, one-hour access tokens, and Bearer authorization.
UserTesting documents the Results API host, completed-session summary pagination, detailed and media endpoints, transcripts, and aggregate QXscores.
UserTesting documents that Results API endpoints are GET-only, return completed sessions, expose sensitive participant and media data on broader endpoints, and are limited to 10 requests per minute.
